scope.description: Trek-native Commander-legal canonical cards in TRK/TRC; explicitly named Commander-legal Star Trek reskins in SDS and Secret Lair Assimilation/Lower Decks. English names and reviewed MTGJSON ASCII aliases only. A reskin qualifies through its exact Trek display name or approved print identity, never the unrelated mechanical name alone.

excluded.name: Loran of the Third Path
excluded.reason: Unrelated canonical reprint appearing in TRC; no Trek display-name identity.
Set/product membership, art, partial names, fuzzy suggestions and editable final names never establish eligibility.
